text.en:
Your explosive <bold [projectile | shape | language] /> inherents subclass debuffs based on its element.

Deals an additional instance of <pve 165 /> <pvp [10] /> damage in a 10 meter radius and applies a debuff matching its element:
•<solar/>70 Scorch Stacks (80 with <solar/>Ember of Ashes)
•<void/>Weaken for <pve 6 /> <pvp [2.5] /> seconds
•<arc/>Blind for 9 seconds 
•<stasis/>80 Slow Stacks
•<strand/>Sever for 5 seconds (7.5 with <strand/>Thread of Continuity)

Effects are applied after the explosion.
